parole.testo: An Anatolian formation, reconstructed as Carian *karkuδ (/⁠karkuⁿd⁠/, “garnet”). In the ancient world, garnets were mined at the Carian city of Orthosia, cut and polished at Alabanda. From there, they were exported across the ancient world. Compare Arabic كَرْكَنْد (karkand), χαλχηδόνιος (khalkhēdón
